placeholders.{{repository}}: The project repository's origin in https form; `nunnarivu routines` fills it in.
placeholders.{{default_branch}}: The repository's default branch; `nunnarivu routines` fills it in.

owner_sets.detail: The project repository ({{repository}}): each firing creates a fresh session on it, and the session's GitHub tools are scoped to it. Attach no other repository.
The cloud environment configured for the kit: Trusted network access or a custom allow-list, never Full, with plugin/cloud/setup.sh as its setup script (architecture §6 item 4).

The machine user of architecture §6 item 1 (decision NF-013): a write collaborator held off the default branch by rulesets; create the routines while claude.ai is connected to that GitHub account, so every session they start acts as it and never as the owner.

routines.name: nunnarivu dispatch
routines.notes: Hourly, and fired on demand from a console session after intake or a merge. Each firing is a fresh session that reconciles, takes in labelled issues, plans with the kit and starts the sessions the plan lists; it starts nothing else.

routines.name: nunnarivu pull-request
routines.notes: Fired by the repository's pull-request events. Repairs the state branch when a package's pull request was merged outside the trusted merge or closed without merging; touches nothing else.
